VERIFICATION & BADGES

Visible trust that moves hiring forward.

Verification badges turn important information into clear, recognisable signals. Each badge represents a specific achievement or confirmation, allowing employers and candidates to understand profile strength at a glance. Badges create consistency across the platform, helping every interaction begin with shared clarity.
